fit1_rule: FIT1 local scientific closures remain valid scoped evidence on the old 950-node lineage, but they are not current product authority and must not be loaded as corrected FIT2 model authority.

workstreams.purpose: Make FIT2 branch/execution authority unambiguous and freeze FIT1 as historical scoped evidence.
Fresh corrected-lineage Arachne fit, preregistration, A100 run-all notebook, terminal evidence, QualifiedSkinIR, hashes and seal.
Selective historical Compiler/runtime restoration, missing product-layer implementation, exact binding/render/motion/runtime/editor closure, then demo.

hard_rules: No old 950-node S/G/W may become current FIT2 authority.
Historical FIT1 checkpoints are evidence only; fresh FIT2 refits may not silently load them.
Arachne FIT2 depends on corrected S/G and the exact Geppetto FIT2 handoff, not on final mesh PASS.
Mesh FAIL is not relabeled PASS; high coverage/precision may be consumed only as explicitly qualified downstream experimental geometry until final product mesh closure.
The productization audit branch owns product restoration work only and must not become scientific S/G/W authority.
PRODUCT_PASS may be considered only after Arachne, final exact mesh-skin/components, professional motion, and exact runtime/export identity closure.
